tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Start here to build a website. Returns templates, industries, style presets and a complete starter document to fill in.

tools.name: start_onboarding
tools.description: Create the user's website. Saves the document as a private draft and returns an approvalUrl; give that link to the user, who signs in with this email and approves to publish. No account or email verification is needed on your side, and no email is sent.

tools.name: onboarding_status
tools.description: Read onboarding status using the private continuation credential.

tools.name: exchange_onboarding
tools.description: After owner approval, exchange the private continuation credential for an API token. Keep returned credentials private.

tools.name: get_business_workspace
tools.description: Read the connected Cockatoo business name and ID.

tools.name: get_business_service_area
tools.description: Read the approved business's saved service area and existing website address.

tools.name: save_business_service_area
tools.description: Update the business service area or existing website. Pass an empty string to clear a field.

tools.name: list_business_locations
tools.description: List business locations and their staff assignments. Set activeOnly to true to exclude inactive locations. An empty staffIds array means all staff can work at the location.

tools.name: get_business_location
tools.description: Read a business location by ID, including its staff assignments and whether it is offered for booking.

tools.name: get_business_brand
tools.description: Read the approved business's saved brand colours, fonts, images and usage settings for website, campaign and Sales drafts.

tools.name: save_business_brand
tools.description: Save the complete brand book for the approved business. Read the current brand and confirm changes with the owner before saving.

tools.name: list_business_services
tools.description: List saved services for the approved business, including pricing text and billing cadence. Pass an ID to look up one saved service.

tools.name: save_business_service
tools.description: Create or update a saved service by ID. Omitted fields keep their current values. Pass null to clear an optional setting. Review changes with the owner before saving.

tools.name: remove_business_service
tools.description: Remove a saved service from the business catalogue. Confirm the service with the owner before removing it.

tools.name: list_appointment_sms_reminders
tools.description: Read up to 50 recent SMS reminder records for an appointment in the approved business.

tools.name: list_appointment_sms_confirmations
tools.description: Read up to 50 recent SMS confirmation records for an appointment in the approved business.

tools.name: list_appointment_changes
tools.description: List recorded changes for an appointment, newest first, with email status and times in Unix milliseconds. Supply changeId to look up a specific change. A sent status records provider acceptance. Check the customer inbox to verify receipt.

tools.name: review_appointment_change_email
tools.description: Read the saved recipient and latest appointment change before asking the owner to approve the email. Pass a proposed message to review it with the booking details. Times are Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: send_appointment_change_email
tools.description: Email the latest appointment change to its saved customer. Confirm the recipient and message with the owner before sending. Supply the change ID, revision and recipient from the reviewed appointment.

tools.name: list_appointment_email_reminders
tools.description: Read up to 50 recent email reminder delivery records for an appointment in the approved business.

tools.name: update_appointment_reminder_settings
tools.description: Set email and SMS appointment reminder preferences and lead time in minutes. Enabling reminders requires Pro.

tools.name: get_appointment_reminder_settings
tools.description: Read the approved business's email and SMS appointment reminder preferences and reminder lead time in minutes.

tools.name: update_appointment_review_settings
tools.description: Set whether completed appointments queue customer review requests and set the HTTPS review URL.

tools.name: get_appointment_review_settings
tools.description: Read whether the approved business requests customer reviews after completed appointments and which review URL it uses.

tools.name: get_booking_settings
tools.description: Read the business's online booking hours, time zone, appointment duration and customer rescheduling notice.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Read public appointment, class and shop links. Links are null when online booking is disabled. The shop link is only available when customers can buy a pass or gift card.

tools.name: update_booking_settings
tools.description: Update an existing booking page's hours, time zone, default duration and availability. Supply the full settings and optionally the customer change notice.

tools.name: get_booking_availability
tools.description: List online appointment times on a business-local date. Use serviceIds for services booked back to back. Slot start times are Unix milliseconds. Some onsite services require an address on the booking page.

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments overlapping a time window in the connected business. Use Unix milliseconds and a window of up to 31 days. Filter by status, paymentStatus, assigneeId, locationId, contactId or serviceId when needed. Set completed to true for completed appointments or false for records without a com

tools.name: complete_appointment
tools.description: Mark a confirmed appointment that has ended as complete using its current revision. This can queue a customer review email if the business has enabled review requests.

tools.name: mark_appointment_no_show
tools.description: Record a no-show for an ended appointment. Read its current revision and agreed fee first. This can retain a prepaid fee, refund the remainder, or charge a saved card. Confirm the policy and fee before calling.

tools.name: get_appointment
tools.description: Read a booking and its current revision by ID in the approved workspace. Share reviewUrl so the owner can review and approve a booking request in Cockatoo. Times are Unix milliseconds. Recorded payment amounts use minor units in the payment currency.

tools.name: list_class_sessions
tools.description: List class sessions and their capacity, booked spots and waitlist counts. Use Unix milliseconds and a window of up to 31 days. Use cancelled to filter by cancellation.

tools.name: get_class_session
tools.description: Read a class session by ID, including capacity, booked spots and waitlist counts. Times are Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: list_class_roster
tools.description: List attendees in a class, including active holds and the waitlist. Attendee names and contact details are private data.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events in the approved business with ticket capacity and allocated places. Filter by published to find drafts or public events. Use from and to in Unix milliseconds to find overlapping events.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Read an event's details, revision and ticket allocation in the approved business.

tools.name: check_in_event_ticket
tools.description: Check in an attendee using the event ID and the ticket code supplied at admission.

tools.name: void_event_ticket
tools.description: Void an eligible unpaid event ticket using its event ID and ticket code.

tools.name: list_event_attendees
tools.description: List ticket holders and admission status for an event in the approved business.

tools.name: save_event_draft
tools.description: Create or update an unpublished event. Use revision 0 to create and the current revision to edit. Ticket amounts are minor units in the specified currency.

tools.name: get_enquiry_auto_reply_settings
tools.description: Read the saved automatic enquiry reply and its revision.

tools.name: get_followup_reminder_settings
tools.description: Read whether website follow-up reminders are enabled and their revision.

tools.name: get_daily_digest_settings
tools.description: Read which daily digest emails are enabled and the business time zone and closing time.

tools.name: save_daily_digest_settings
tools.description: Set whether the owner receives the Today and Tomorrow daily digest emails. Supply the preferences you want to change.

tools.name: list_daily_digest_sends
tools.description: List recent daily digest send attempts for the approved business. Filter by Today or Tomorrow and inclusive business-local dates (YYYY-MM-DD). claimed_at is Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: list_timesheet_staff
tools.description: List staff names and IDs for recording time in the approved business.

tools.name: list_timesheets
tools.description: Read staff time entries and payroll export summaries for the approved business. Supply an inclusive work-date range as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: save_timesheet_draft
tools.description: Create or edit a draft staff time entry. Use revision 0 for a new entry and the current revision for an edit. Enter local start and end times with the shift time zone.

tools.name: submit_timesheet
tools.description: Submit a draft staff time entry for owner approval. Supply the draft revision you reviewed.

tools.name: approve_timesheet
tools.description: Approve a submitted staff time entry for payroll. Call only after the owner approves the specific entry and revision.

tools.name: return_timesheet
tools.description: Return a submitted or approved staff time entry to draft for correction.

tools.name: void_timesheet
tools.description: Void a draft or submitted staff time entry after owner approval.

tools.name: create_payroll_export
tools.description: Create a payroll export from approved entries and lock those revisions. Show the owner the selected entries and payroll codes before proceeding. Reuse the same export ID and inputs for an identical retry.

tools.name: get_payroll_export
tools.description: Read the summary and signed-in download link for a saved payroll export.

tools.name: get_timesheet
tools.description: Read a staff time entry and its current revision in the approved business.

tools.name: get_timesheet_history
tools.description: Read the recorded changes to a staff time entry in the approved business.

tools.name: list_store_catalogue
tools.description: List products and stock for the approved business. Prices and shipping amounts are minor units in the store currency.

tools.name: list_booking_products
tools.description: List booking packages and membership products in the approved business.

tools.name: save_booking_product
tools.description: Create or edit a booking package or membership. Include its ID to edit or set active to false to retire it. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: save_business_location
tools.description: Create or edit a business location. Omitted address, phone, staffIds and active fields keep their current values when editing. Pass an empty staffIds array to allow all staff. Set active to false to stop offering it for booking. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: issue_customer_pass
tools.description: Issue a session package sold in person and email its redemption code to the customer. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: list_customer_passes
tools.description: List up to 500 recently issued customer passes with session usage and expiry.

tools.name: list_customer_pass_uses
tools.description: List recorded uses and returns for a customer pass, newest first, including prior membership periods.

tools.name: record_customer_pass_use
tools.description: Record one manually used session on a customer pass. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: return_customer_pass_use
tools.description: Return the most recent manually used session on a customer pass. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: get_gift_card_sales_settings
tools.description: Read whether gift card sales are enabled on the approved business booking page.

tools.name: update_gift_card_sales_settings
tools.description: Enable or disable gift card sales on the approved business booking page.

tools.name: list_gift_cards
tools.description: List up to 500 recently issued gift cards with balances and currencies.

tools.name: issue_gift_card
tools.description: Issue a gift card sold in person and email its redemption code to the recipient. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: redeem_gift_card
tools.description: Apply a gift card to an in-person purchase. Use the card ID and an amount in its currency's minor units. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: void_gift_card
tools.description: Void an issued gift card in the approved business and zero its remaining balance. This permanently prevents redemption.

tools.name: list_gift_card_entries
tools.description: List balance changes for an issued gift card in the approved business. Use the card ID from list_gift_cards.

tools.name: list_store_orders
tools.description: List order status, totals and refunds for the approved business. Amounts are minor units in each order's currency.

tools.name: get_store_order
tools.description: Read an order's line items, totals, tracking and refund status in the approved business.

tools.name: get_store_order_reconciliation
tools.description: Read recorded payment and refund reconciliation for an order. Amounts are minor units in the order currency. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: fulfil_store_order
tools.description: Mark a paid store order as fulfilled after it has been dispatched. Optionally record its tracking link.

tools.name: adjust_store_stock
tools.description: Record a stock increase or decrease for a product in the approved store. Reuse the same adjustment ID and details on retry.

tools.name: save_store_product
tools.description: Create or edit a store product. Use revision 0 to create, or the current revision to edit. Money amounts are in minor units of the store currency.

tools.name: save_store_shipping_rate
tools.description: Create or edit a store shipping rate. Use revision 0 to create, or the current revision to edit. Money amounts are in minor units of the store currency.

tools.name: save_store_settings
tools.description: Save the store name, currency and publication setting. Use revision 0 for a new store or the saved revision from list_store_catalogue. Ask the owner to approve any change to public availability.

tools.name: get_loyalty_program
tools.description: Read the store loyalty programme, including points and the reward. Spend per point is in minor units of the programme currency.

tools.name: list_loyalty_members
tools.description: Find loyalty members by name or membership reference and read their point balances. Use a narrower search if more results exist.

tools.name: get_loyalty_activity
tools.description: Read the latest 30 point changes for a member in the approved business.

tools.name: redeem_loyalty_reward
tools.description: Record a reward redemption for the specified member and programme revision. Reuse the redemption ID on retry.

tools.name: save_loyalty_program
tools.description: Create or update the loyalty programme. Use revision 0 to create or the current revision to edit. Spend per point is in minor units of the programme currency.

tools.name: list_email_campaigns
tools.description: List campaign names, subjects and revisions in the approved business.

tools.name: get_welcome_email
tools.description: Read the saved welcome email draft and the draft and sender settings revisions used by the active automation.

tools.name: save_welcome_email_draft
tools.description: Save the welcome email draft for owner review. Use revision 0 for a new draft or the current revision from get_welcome_email.

tools.name: get_email_settings
tools.description: Read the saved sender, reply-to and footer defaults for the approved business.

tools.name: save_email_settings
tools.description: Save sender, reply-to and footer defaults for future campaign emails. Read the current settings revision before saving.

tools.name: get_email_sender_status
tools.description: Read the approved business's Email account state, sender domain and verification checks.

tools.name: get_email_performance
tools.description: Read campaign delivery and engagement totals and comparison periods for the approved business.

tools.name: get_email_campaign_draft
tools.description: Read a saved campaign's content and revision in the approved business.

tools.name: list_email_campaign_runs
tools.description: List campaign reviews and sends in the approved business, optionally filtered by campaign ID.

tools.name: get_email_campaign_run
tools.description: Read a campaign review or send run and its delivery counts in the approved business.

tools.name: preview_email_audience
tools.description: Count eligible campaign recipients for all contacts or a tag. The count reflects current consent and suppression records.

tools.name: save_email_campaign_draft
tools.description: Save an email campaign draft for review in Cockatoo. Use revision 0 for a new draft or the current revision to update it.

tools.name: prepare_email_campaign_review
tools.description: Prepare a saved campaign and its eligible audience for owner confirmation in Cockatoo. Choose either a segment or contact IDs. Optionally propose a send time within the next 30 days as Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: list_pipeline_assignees
tools.description: List the active team members who can be assigned enquiries in the approved business.

tools.name: update_pipeline_enquiry
tools.description: Update an enquiry stage and assignment using its current pipeline revision. Pass null to clear the assignment.

tools.name: triage_contact_enquiry
tools.description: Reopen, mark read or close a specific enquiry for a contact in the approved business.

tools.name: mark_contact_messages_read
tools.description: Mark the inbound messages for a contact in the approved business as read.

tools.name: add_contact_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a contact in the approved business. Reuse the same request ID on retry.

tools.name: set_contact_follow_up
tools.description: Set or clear a contact's follow-up date using the current contact revision.

tools.name: set_contact_type
tools.description: Change a contact's type using the current contact revision.

tools.name: set_contact_archived
tools.description: Archive or restore a contact using the current contact revision.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact in the approved business. Reuse requestId when retrying the same creation.

tools.name: update_contact_profile
tools.description: Edit a contact's name, email, phone, company or address using the current contact revision. Omitted fields keep their saved values.

tools.name: set_inbox_assignment
tools.description: Assign a contact's Inbox conversation to a business team member, or pass null to clear it. Use list_pipeline_assignees to find member IDs.

tools.name: get_inbox_assignment
tools.description: Read the assigned team member ID for a contact's Inbox conversation in the approved business.

tools.name: list_inbox_saved_replies
tools.description: List reusable Inbox replies saved in the approved business.

tools.name: save_inbox_saved_reply
tools.description: Create or update a reusable Inbox reply. Reuse the same reply ID when retrying.

tools.name: delete_inbox_saved_reply
tools.description: Delete a reusable Inbox reply from the approved business.

tools.name: get_inbox_ai_settings
tools.description: Read the approved business’s Inbox AI preferences and saved automatic draft count.

tools.name: update_inbox_ai_settings
tools.description: Update Inbox AI preferences for the approved business. Supply only the preferences to change.

tools.name: summarize_inbox_conversation
tools.description: Summarize a contact's recent conversation in the approved business using its Inbox AI settings.

tools.name: draft_inbox_reply
tools.description: Generate an Inbox reply draft for the owner to review.

tools.name: list_inbox_auto_drafts
tools.description: List saved automatic reply draft references for a contact, newest first. Use get_inbox_auto_draft to read the text.

tools.name: get_inbox_auto_draft
tools.description: Read the saved automatic reply draft for a customer message in the approved business. Returns null when no draft exists.

tools.name: prepare_inbox_auto_draft
tools.description: Prepare or retrieve the shared Inbox reply draft for a customer message when automatic drafts are enabled in the approved business.

tools.name: rewrite_inbox_reply
tools.description: Rewrite draft reply text for owner review using the approved business's Inbox AI settings.

tools.name: list_inbox_waiting_requests
tools.description: List the approved business's oldest unanswered enquiries and booking requests, including requests from the last 90 days.

tools.name: get_inbox_response_metrics
tools.description: Read aggregate Inbox response metrics for the approved business over the last 7 or 30 days. Median first response is in milliseconds.

tools.name: get_contact_follow_up_summary
tools.description: Count contacts with follow-ups due in the approved business on or before the supplied business-local date.

tools.name: list_contact_tag_options
tools.description: List available contact tags in the approved business.

tools.name: list_contact_tags
tools.description: Read the tags assigned to a contact in the approved business.

tools.name: add_contact_tag
tools.description: Assign a tag to a contact in the approved business.

tools.name: remove_contact_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from a contact in the approved business.

tools.name: list_booking_schedules
tools.description: List staff or resource schedules, their current revisions and the business time zone.

tools.name: save_booking_schedule
tools.description: Replace a staff or resource schedule. Supply its current revision, or null when it has no saved schedule. Hours follow the business time zone.

tools.name: list_appointment_services
tools.description: List saved services with appointment duration, buffer, staff and resource assignments, online booking availability, and on-site service postcodes.

tools.name: list_appointment_staff
tools.description: List team members and bookable staff who can be assigned appointments in the approved business.

tools.name: create_class_sessions
tools.description: Create one class or a recurring series in the connected business. Times are Unix milliseconds. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: update_class_session
tools.description: Edit one class in the approved business. Supply the full session details. Times are Unix milliseconds. Moving a class notifies attendees.

tools.name: cancel_class_session
tools.description: Cancel a class in the approved business, return eligible payments and notify attendees.

tools.name: add_class_attendee
tools.description: Add an attendee to a class in the approved business. If the group does not fit, join the waitlist. Sends a booking or waitlist notice.

tools.name: remove_class_attendee
tools.description: Remove a booking from a class roster by booking ID, return eligible payments and notify attendees promoted from the waitlist.

tools.name: list_appointment_payments
tools.description: List recorded payments for an appointment, oldest first, in pages of up to 50. Amounts use each payment's currency minor units.

tools.name: get_appointment_payments
tools.description: Read the payment ledger and outstanding balance for an appointment. Amounts are in minor units.

tools.name: record_appointment_payment
tools.description: Record money already received for an appointment. Supply the amount in minor units and the date in the business time zone. An optional tip, in minor units on top of the amount, goes to the person the appointment is with. Reuse the same paymentId on retry.

tools.name: remove_appointment_payment
tools.description: Remove an incorrectly recorded manual appointment payment from the ledger by payment ID.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel a single appointment in the approved business using its current revision. Cancellation may refund a prepaid appointment.

tools.name: create_appointment
tools.description: Create a requested appointment for a saved contact. Times are Unix milliseconds. Reuse the same idempotency key when retrying.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Change an appointment's start and end using its current revision. Times are Unix milliseconds. Review the customer notification in Cockatoo.

tools.name: confirm_appointment
tools.description: Confirm a pending booking using its current revision. Obtain owner approval for the booking first. This records a confirmation. Use the review link to email it from Cockatoo.

tools.name: create_quote_draft
tools.description: Create a quote draft for review in Cockatoo. Pass an enquiry ID to link it and use its customer name and email; requires leads:read. Use savedServices to copy service details from this business. Supply unitAmount in minor units when a service has no fixed price. Reuse the same document ID and docume

tools.name: create_invoice_draft
tools.description: Create a invoice draft for review in Cockatoo. Pass an enquiry ID to link it and use its customer name and email; requires leads:read. Use savedServices to copy service details from this business. Supply unitAmount in minor units when a service has no fixed price. Reuse the same document ID and docu

tools.name: list_sales_documents
tools.description: List quote and invoice references, statuses, revisions and recurring billing cadence. Set draftsOnly to list editable drafts or recurringOnly to list recurring invoices.

tools.name: get_sales_draft
tools.description: Read editable quote or invoice content and revision for a draft in the approved business.

tools.name: prepare_sales_document_review
tools.description: Check the saved quote or invoice revision and return its Cockatoo review link for the owner to inspect before sending.

tools.name: update_sales_draft
tools.description: Replace the editable contents of a quote or invoice draft using its current revision.

tools.name: create_invoice_from_quote
tools.description: Create a draft invoice from an accepted quote in the approved business. Any required deposit must already be paid. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: get_sales_document_status
tools.description: Read a quote or invoice status and current revision by ID. Invoice amounts are in minor units of the returned currency.

tools.name: get_sales_report
tools.description: Summarise the Cockatoo invoice report for an inclusive date range on the business clock. Amounts are AUD minor units. Narrow the date range if truncated.

tools.name: record_invoice_payment
tools.description: Record money already received for a sent invoice. Use its currency minor units and the business-local date. Recording can expire an open online checkout session. Reuse the same paymentId on retry.

tools.name: remove_invoice_payment
tools.description: Remove an incorrectly recorded manual invoice payment by payment ID.

tools.name: set_invoice_reminder_day
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic overdue invoice emails for one supported offset in days after the due date. This changes the schedule for the entire approved business.

tools.name: get_invoice_reminder_settings
tools.description: Read the enabled invoice reminder offsets in days after the due date.

tools.name: list_sales_document_deliveries
tools.description: List a quote or invoice's delivery records, newest first. Set remindersOnly to include only automatic invoice reminders. Timestamps use Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: set_recurring_invoice_renewal
tools.description: Schedule a recurring invoice subscription to end after its current billing period, or let it renew. Confirm the change with the business owner before calling.

tools.name: get_recurring_invoice_history
tools.description: Read the subscription status and billing history for a recurring invoice in the approved business. Amounts are in minor units and timestamps are Unix seconds. Use nextCursor for more history. Share reviewUrl with the owner to review an unpaid renewal and retry it in Sales.

tools.name: list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List recorded payments and refunds for an invoice in the approved business. Amounts are minor units in each payment's currency.

tools.name: create_sales_payment_link
tools.description: Create a customer payment link. The amount is before tax in minor units. Reuse the same ID and details on retry.

tools.name: set_sales_payment_link_active
tools.description: Pause or resume accepting payments through an existing payment link.

tools.name: list_sales_payment_links
tools.description: List up to 100 payment links, including whether they accept payments and their received totals. Filter by ID or whether the link is active. Amounts are minor units in the link currency.

tools.name: list_payment_link_payments
tools.description: List payments received through a payment link, newest first. Amounts use the returned currency's minor units. Invoice IDs can be used to look up the resulting invoices.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: List contract titles and signature status for the approved business.

tools.name: save_contract_draft_reminder_settings
tools.description: Set the reminder schedule for a draft contract. Reminders begin after the contract is issued.

tools.name: list_contract_deliveries
tools.description: List signature request, reminder and signed-copy email delivery records, newest first. Set remindersOnly to true to return reminder attempts. Delivery times are Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: get_contract_reminder_settings
tools.description: Read a contract's reminder schedule and number of reminders sent. The next reminder time is in Unix milliseconds when scheduled.

tools.name: update_contract_draft
tools.description: Replace the editable terms and customer details of a standalone draft contract. Supply its current content hash.

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Read a contract's terms and signature status in the approved business.

tools.name: prepare_contract_review
tools.description: Check an unsigned contract draft against the content hash returned by get_contract and identify it for owner review in Cockatoo.

tools.name: save_contract_template
tools.description: Create or replace a reusable contract template. Use the same template ID on retry.

tools.name: list_contract_templates
tools.description: Read agreement template names and terms available in the approved business.

tools.name: apply_quote_agreement_template
tools.description: Copy a saved agreement template into a draft quote using its current revision.

tools.name: create_contract_draft
tools.description: Create an unsigned contract draft for review in Cockatoo. Reuse the same idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Read the owner’s site and current revision. State is draft or live.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create one structured draft. Does not publish. Fails if the owner already has a site.

tools.name: save_site
tools.description: Replace the draft using the current revision. Does not change the live publication.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Change only some fields of the draft, using the current revision. `changes` is a JSON Merge Patch over the SiteDocument: objects merge, null removes a field, and arrays (services, gallery, pages, sections) are replaced whole. Does not change the live publication.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List retained uploaded images owned by this site.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (5 MiB maximum). Returns an assetId for the document.

tools.name: upload_image_from_url
tools.description: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (5 MiB maximum) from a public https URL. Prefer this to upload_image. Returns an assetId for the document.

tools.name: preview_site
tools.description: Return a private link to the saved draft, valid for 15 minutes. Open it, or give it to the owner to review before publishing. Images are not shown and enquiries are disabled.

tools.name: publication_status
tools.description: Read publication state and published revision.

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish the saved revision to a public hosted address. Requires sites:publish.

tools.name: unpublish_site
tools.description: Remove the current public publication. Draft and enquiries are retained.

tools.name: site_analytics
tools.description: Visits, page views, enquiry submissions, button clicks, top pages and traffic sources for the published site over the last 30 days.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Custom domains connected to the site, their status (pending_dns, verifying, ssl_provisioning, active, error) and the DNS records the owner must set. The owner adds domains in Cockatoo.

tools.name: list_enquiries
tools.description: Read enquiries sent through the owner's website, newest first, 100 at a time. Requires leads:read. Pass before and cursorId from the last enquiry to read older ones.

tools.name: list_pipeline_enquiries
tools.description: List website enquiries with their pipeline stage, assignment and revision. Filter by stage, search text or assignee.

tools.name: get_contact_history
tools.description: Read a contact and their recent enquiries, notes and messages. Pass both cursor fields from next to read older history.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Read the owner's customer contacts for this website, most recent enquiry first. Requires leads:read. Set due to see contacts whose follow-up date has arrived, or newOnly for unread enquiries. Use upcoming for future follow-ups, or tag to filter by contact tag key.

tools.name: leads_summary
tools.description: Counts of contacts, customers, follow-ups due today and unread enquiries. Requires leads:read. Use this to answer 'any new leads?'

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "exchange_onboarding" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: After owner approval, exchange the private continuation credential for an API token. Keep returned credentials private.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "mark_appointment_no_show" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Record a no-show for an ended appointment. Read its current revision and agreed fee first. This can retain a prepaid fee, refund the remainder, or charge a save…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "set_recurring_invoice_renewal" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Schedule a recurring invoice subscription to end after its current billing period, or let it renew. Confirm the change with the business owner before calling.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_contacts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read the owner's customer contacts for this website, most recent enquiry first. Requires leads:read. Set due to see contacts whose follow-up date has arrived, or newOnly for unread enquiries." → after: "Read the owner's customer contacts for this website, most recent enquiry first. Requires leads:read. Set due to see contacts whose follow-up date has arrived, or newOnly for unread enquiries. Use upcoming for future follow-ups, or tag to filter by contact tag key."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
